description_en: Binds a storage bucket to one or more applications in ApsaraVideo VOD
description_zh: 为视频点播的子应用绑定存储Bucket
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-vod-storage-for-app --app-id app-0000 --storage-location example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --storage-type vod_oss_bucket --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddVodStorageForApp

parameters.description_en: The IDs of applications. You can obtain the application ID from the `AppId` parameter in the response to the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) or [ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 应用ID列表。应用ID为调用[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口或[ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~)接口返回参数`AppId`的值。
parameters.help_en: The IDs of applications. You can obtain the application ID from the `AppId` parameter in the response to the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) or [ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID列表。应用ID为调用[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口或[ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~)接口返回参数`AppId`的值
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The address of an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This parameter does not take effect. You can call this operation to add only VOD buckets.
parameters.description_zh: OSS bucket地址。当StorageType为user_oss_bucket时，该字段必填。
parameters.help_en: The address of an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This parameter does not take effect. You can call this operation to add only VOD buckets
parameters.help_zh: OSS bucket地址。当StorageType为user_oss_bucket时，该字段必填
parameters.name: storage_location
